# Notes from Presentation

## Prediction Options

- e.g., `broom::augment(..., interval = "confidence")` vs `broom::augment(..., interval = "prediction")`

| Feature | interval = "confidence" | interval = "prediction" |
|----|----|----|
| What it measures | Uncertainty around the mean outcome ($E[Y\Vert{}X]$) for a given $X$. | Uncertainty around a single new individual observation ($Y$) for a given $X$. |
| Width | Narrower. | Wider. |
| Sources of Variance | Only accounts for the uncertainty in the model parameters ($\beta$ coefficients). | Accounts for parameter uncertainty PLUS the random residual variance ($\sigma ^{2}$) of individuals. |
| Effect of Sample Size ($n$) | Shrinks toward zero width as the sample size approaches infinity. | Will never shrink to zero; it is bounded by the natural variance ($\sigma$) of the data. |
